rules.text: 1.1 A waiting period of 30 days applies to all illnesses from the policy start date, except accidents.
1.2 Pre-existing conditions are covered only after 24 months of continuous coverage.
1.3 Maternity expenses will be covered after a waiting period of 9 months.
2.1 The Insured must pay a deductible of 500 per claim before the Insurer pays any amount.
2.2 A co-payment of 10% applies to every claim for insured persons above the age of 60.
3.1 The Insured must notify the Insurer of a hospitalisation within 48 hours of admission.
3.2 Claim documents must be submitted within 15 days after discharge from hospital.
3.3 The Insurer shall acknowledge each claim within 3 working days of receipt.
3.4 The Insurer shall settle or reject a claim within 30 days of receiving all documents.
4.1 Room rent is limited to 1% of the sum insured per day.
4.2 The maximum payable for cataract surgery is 25000 per eye.
5.1 The Insurer will not pay for cosmetic surgery unless it is required following an accident.
5.2 Claims arising from self-inflicted injury are not covered.
5.3 If the Insured fails to disclose a material fact, the Insurer may reject the claim.
1.1 A compulsory excess of 250 applies to each own-damage claim.
1.2 An additional excess of 500 applies if the driver is under 25 years of age.
2.1 The policyholder must report an accident to the Insurer within 24 hours.
2.2 The policyholder must report theft to the police immediately and to the Insurer within 48 hours.
2.3 The policyholder must not admit liability or make any offer of payment without the written consent of the Insurer.
3.1 If the cost of repair exceeds 75% of the market value, the vehicle will be treated as a total loss.
3.2 The Insurer will pay the market value of the vehicle immediately before the loss, less the applicable excess.
3.3 Settlement of a repairable claim shall be made within 10 working days of the repair invoice being received.
4.1 A no claim discount of 20% applies after one claim-free year and 40% after two claim-free years.
4.2 The no claim discount is forfeited if a claim is paid in the policy year.
5.1 The Insurer is not liable for damage occurring while the driver is under the influence of alcohol.
5.2 Cover is provided for use within the territory of the country only, unless extended in writing.
1.1 The claims handler must register every claim in the claims system on the day it is received.
1.2 The claims handler shall verify policy status and premium payment before any further processing.
1.3 If the policy has lapsed on the date of loss, the claim must be declined and the claimant informed in writing.
2.1 Claims above 10000 must be referred to a senior adjuster for approval.
2.2 Claims above 50000 require approval from the claims manager and a loss-adjuster assessment.
2.3 A site inspection must be completed within 5 working days of assignment for all property claims.
2.4 If fraud is suspected, the handler must escalate the claim to the Special Investigations Unit and must not communicate a decision to the claimant.
3.1 Payment must not be released until all required approvals are recorded in the claim file.
3.2 Approved payments shall be released within 7 days of final approval.
3.3 The handler may grant an interim payment of up to 30% of the estimated loss where the claim is undisputed.
4.1 A claim file shall be closed within 14 days after the final payment is confirmed.
4.2 The claimant is entitled to a written explanation within 5 days of any rejection.
Buildings | 1000000 | 1000
Contents | 250000 | 500
Business interruption | 500000 | 7 days
2.1 The Insured must maintain a working fire alarm system at all insured premises.
2.2 The Insurer will not pay for theft unless there is evidence of forcible entry.
2.3 Losses must be notified within 7 days of discovery.
Flood | 14 days
Subsidence | 60 days
1.1 Trip cancellation is covered up to 5000 per person if the insured falls ill before departure.
1.2 The Insured must notify the Insurer of a cancellation within 72 hours of the cancellation event.
1.3 A medical certificate must be provided for every claim arising from illness.
2.1 Baggage loss is limited to 1500 per trip and 300 per single item.
2.2 Delay of baggage for more than 12 hours entitles the insured to an emergency purchase allowance of 200.
3.1 Emergency medical expenses are covered up to 100000 per person.
3.2 The Insurer will not cover treatment for a condition that was diagnosed in the 12 months before the trip.
3.3 The Insured must contact the assistance provider within 24 hours of any hospital admission.
4.1 Claims must be submitted within 90 days after the end of the trip.
4.2 No benefit is payable for activities undertaken against local government advice.
1.1 Underwriters may accept risks with a sum insured up to 500000 without referral.
1.2 Risks with a sum insured above 500000 must be referred to the underwriting manager.
1.3 Applicants with more than 3 claims in the last 5 years must be referred and cannot be accepted at standard rates.
2.1 The proposal form must be signed and dated by the applicant before a quotation is issued.
2.2 If the property is unoccupied for more than 30 days, the underwriter must apply the vacancy condition.
3.1 A quotation is valid for 30 days from the date of issue.
3.2 The underwriter shall respond to a broker submission within 2 working days.
3.3 Discounts exceeding 15% must not be offered without written approval.
